selection.rule: First two chronological manufacturer-1 reports with problem 'no heat' or 'not enough heat', outside substations 21, 4, 7, 12, 24, 19, and 11 and on distinct substations, having >=100 prior-24-hour samples and nonempty required hc1 fields; reports 29 and 47 selected before cycle-4 inference.
selection.cutoff: measurement timestamp <= report date; prior records strictly earlier

event_description: Motor control valve does not open.
fault_label: Motorised control valve (primary side): Control valve jams when closed
note: Published report fields are retrospective; they are not a real-time ground truth at the decision time.
